name: National Cybersecurity Strategy of the Kingdom of Morocco (Stratégie Nationale de Cybersécurité 2030) (2012)

description: Official 2012 edition of National Cybersecurity Strategy of the Kingdom of Morocco (Stratégie Nationale de Cybersécurité 2030) (National Cybersecurity Strategy of the Kingdom of Morocco (Stratégie Nationale de Cybersécurité 2030) (2012)), published by General Directorate of Information Systems Security (DGSSI) & Ministry of Digital Transition (Morocco) (dgssi.gov.ma).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by General Directorate of Information Systems Security (DGSSI) & Ministry of Digital Transition (Morocco) (dgssi.gov.ma) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for General Directorate of Information Systems Security (DGSSI) & Ministry of Digital Transition (Morocco) (dgssi.gov.ma).
